notes.title: Citk2 DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
Friends! It's happening! The page of the long-awaited sequel Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War is available in Steam. 

And along with it there is a demo-version, which will allow you to play in the first game year - 1985, and enjoy the events and numerous mechanics of the new game. 

We ask you not only to play the demo version, but also to add the new game to your wishlist, subscribe for updates and wait for news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922740

notes.title: Update Navruz (03.2020)
notes.notes:
Comrades! Long time no see!

This update includes the following:
- Re-balace of the agricultural investments 
- Re-balance of the pre-game event "Kosygin's reform"
- Pop-up windows were added for modificators 
- Events of the 1985 year were partly re-written
- Bugs were fixed.

This is not the last update. The next update will be major.

Also our new DLC was released, you can buy it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255950/Crisis_in_the_Kremlin_Homeland_of_the_Revolution/

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Update LNY 30.01.2020
notes.notes:
Comrades! Long time no see!

This update includes the following:
- Changed the interface of ministers, added their brief description and description of influence.
- A complete change in the mechanics of withdrawing funds from the budget.
- A thoroughly revised description of the doctrines.
- Completely remade pre-game events of 1985 and 1991.
- Added additional correlation between the doctrines of the economy.
- New names of ministries depending on doctrines.
- Important bugs were fixed.
- Small rebalance (including the environment's investment!).

This is not the last major update. The next major update will include new events, and the old ones will be redone.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: New Update (LY 11.02.18)
notes.notes:
Comrades!
You can update the game to this new version.

What's new?

Empty button in France disappeared.
Investment in Education was rebalanced.
Reformers have a better chance to appear now.
Now you can move the map not only by using keyboard.
5 slots for saving.
Now the ending "Zemsharnaya Sovietskaya Respublika" cannot be achieved, if there is at least one nationalist at the head of any Soviet republic. 
The transfer of the Kuril Islands on the event was corrected.

Have a good game!
